meta.title: Implement global PopenExecutor with tagging for improved process control and probe isolation
meta.body_summary: Implement a global PopenExecutor with tagging to replace per-context executors, enabling selective query interruption and improved probe isolation.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot implemented global executor with tagging; reviewer requested design changes (sig tag, required tag, simplified init) via multiple CHANGES_REQUESTED rounds, currently open and under iterative review.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 728 changed lines across 6 files, this is a medium-sized refactor. As an open performance-related feature PR, it is undergoing iterative review to align with project design conventions, with no merge or close decision yet.

review_details.concern_detail: Reviewer requested: use ctx.info.sig instead of name for unique tagging; make tag non-optional in PopenFuture and PathContext with assertion; simplify global executor to module-level init; remove unnecessary tests; use generic tag parameter instead of probe_tag.
review_details.performance_claim: Improved process control and probe isolation via global PopenExecutor with tagging, reducing sequential solver process creation and enabling selective interruption.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent successfully implemented global executor and tagging but required iterations on design details: unique tag source (sig vs name), non-optional tag enforcement, and initialization pattern. The change is technically sound but needed human fine-tuning.

detection_detail.code_reading: 0xkarmacoma left detailed line-specific feedback on tagging uniqueness, optionality, and initialization approach.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or profiler data; performance claim is architectural and relies on narrative of reduced process overhead.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Multiple fix commits responded to reviewer's CHANGES_REQUESTED, adjusting tag source, making tag required, simplifying executor init, and removing tests.

core_change_summary.description: Introduced global PopenExecutor singleton with tagging system to replace per-context executors; added interrupt(tag) method for selective query cancellation; removed executor field from SolvingContext; updated callers to use get_global_executor() with ctx.info.sig as tag.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test files iteratively modified: test_global_executor.py removed, replaced by test_executor.py; test_solver_integration.py deleted per reviewer request.
change_trajectory: Implemented global PopenExecutor with tagging and interrupt (e0545e1).
Final implementation with tests and linting (f4bd62d).
Updated to use ctx.info.sig for unique tag (00b767f).
Made tag required, added assertions, simplified global executor init to module-level (b421f6e).
Simplified tagging API, removed unnecessary tests, renamed test file to test_executor.py (d0262bc).

review_signals.summary: Requested using ctx.info.sig instead of ctx.info.name to ensure tag uniqueness.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot changed all tag usage to ctx.info.sig in commit 00b767f.

review_signals.summary: Demanded that tag be non-optional in PopenFuture and PathContext, with assertions to prevent empty tags.
review_signals.action_taken: Committed b421f6e made tag required and added assertions.

review_signals.summary: Suggested replacing lazy global executor init with simple module-level variable, lock unnecessary.
review_signals.action_taken: Commit b421f6e removed threading lock and used direct assignment.

review_signals.summary: Advocated for a generic 'tag' parameter in handle_assertion_violation instead of probe-specific 'probe_tag'.
review_signals.action_taken: Commit d0262bc renamed parameter to 'tag' and simplified down-stream usage.

review_signals.summary: Requested deletion of test_solver_integration.py and empty-tag test, and renaming of test_global_executor.py to test_executor.py.
review_signals.action_taken: Deletions and rename applied in d0262bc.

review_signals.summary: Acknowledged changes in multiple inline replies (e.g., fixed tag, removed empty tag test).

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with initial global executor implementation and tests.
Reviewer 0xkarmacoma provided first round of CHANGES_REQUESTED: use sig for tag, make tag non-optional, simplify init.
Copilot responded with commits 00b767f and b421f6e addressing feedback.
Second round of CHANGES_REQUESTED focused on generic tag parameter and test file cleanup.
Copilot applied final commit d0262bc removing files and renaming test file.
PR remains open, under further review or pending additional feedback.
